root_idea.summary: A root field centered on gentle return, quieting, and the restoration of settled relations.
root_idea.development: The lexical field extends from gentle or quiet movement to repentance and return, leniency, reconciliation, and related social bonds. The Jewish designation is traditionally connected with repentance, while Hūd is also the proper name of a prophet.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Form I verb هَادَ.
Displayed as the distinct proper name of the prophet Hūd.
Displayed as the distinct proper/collective designation for the Jews.

senses.definition: To return or turn back in repentance; to return to the truth or to God.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction هُدْنَا إِلَيْكَ, the verb denotes repentant return toward God and is construed with إِلَى as implying return.

senses.definition: To become Jewish or follow the Jewish religion.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of adopting or belonging to the Jewish religious way; Quranic translations may render the form as “became Jews,” “were Jews,” or “are Jews” according to context.

senses.definition: The proper name of the prophet Hūd.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a personal name in direct address, genitive constructions, and references to the prophet and his people.

senses.definition: The Jews; the Jewish people or community.
senses.usage_conditions: A collective/proper designation for the Jewish people, distinct in the Quranic morphology from the personal name Hūd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return or turn back from one state to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The general lexical sense includes return from evil to good or from good to evil; the repentant Quranic construction is separately represented under the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone a Jew; to turn, teach, or initiate someone into Judaism.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II usage, including making a person or child follow the Jewish religion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The gentle, weak-sounding conversation of jinn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A term applied to the quiet manner of the jinns’ voices.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reiterate, quaver, trill, or utter a low and gentle voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of soft, weak, low, or languid speech and vocalization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sing, or to gladden and divert by singing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II usage describing singing and its entertaining or heartening effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go or proceed gently, slowly, or at a leisurely pace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a slow and gentle manner of walking or movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To intoxicate a person and make him languid or sleepy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a beverage or wine producing intoxication, languor, and sleepiness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rest, become still, or be quiet and at rest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes cessation of movement or a state of repose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sleep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form II usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be gentle or to act in a gentle manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general description of gentle conduct or behavior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of wind, to murmur or sound gently over sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the soft murmuring sound made by wind passing over sand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat part of a camel’s hump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II usage referring to eating the camel-hump substance called هَوَدَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make peace with, reconcile with, or restore oneself to another’s favor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction for peace-making, reconciliation, or renewed favor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline mutually toward one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used reciprocally of two parties mutually inclining toward or accommodating one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return to someone or something repeatedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III usage expressing repeated return or renewed approach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To walk gently while imitating the movements associated with Jewish recitation or reading.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic Form V usage specifically describing a gentle, imitative manner of walking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become allied, seek alliance, or draw near through a relationship or other sacred and inviolable bond.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of affiliating oneself through kinship or another bond regarded as sacred, inviolable, or conferring respect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel’s hump, or the base of the hump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural/collective form هَوَد is also reported for the hump substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gentleness, leniency, quietness, or a favorable and conciliatory disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe conduct intended to settle an affair, bring peace or reconciliation, show affection or favor, or facilitate an arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sacred or inviolable bond, including a bond of relationship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The bond is one regarded as deserving respect or reverence and as conferring a claim to consideration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who returns, repents, and returns to the truth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle of هَادَ; its plural is هُودٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Jewish religion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine abstract noun denoting Judaism as a religious system.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low, quiet, or softly voiced singing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of singing that is not loud.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gladdening and diverting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival usage describing something that entertains or cheers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who allies himself, seeks alliance, or draws near through a sacred or inviolable bond.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial designation derived from the alliance sense of تَهَوَّدَ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: General return and repentant return are both represented.
Making or teaching someone to be Jewish.
Intoxicating and inducing languor or sleep.
Gentleness, leniency, quietness, and conciliatory favor.
The Jews as a tribe or people; Quran-attested lexical evidence.
One who seeks alliance through a sacred bond.

cautions: The identical spelling هُود represents two distinct QAC proper-noun groups here: the prophet Hūd and the Jewish people.
Lane’s historical citation for هُودًا in entry 10733 is not converted into a modern verse location; Quran examples use only the independently supplied QAC locations.
